d: Platinum white, straight hair flows long and voluminous, featuring center-parted bangs that frame a youthful, mature face with sharp, glowing red eyes. The slender, athletic build is adorned in a sleek, futuristic bodysuit and plated armor in a color palette of deep navy, charcoal grey, and white, accented by gold trim. Two curved black horns sprout from the head, complemented by a long, thick, dark grey scaled tail.
